name: Camille Dubois

moves.name: Glasswork
moves.description: Pulls molten barriers out of the air — cover on demand that enemies burn on.

moves.name: Anneal
moves.description: A heat-wrap on an ally that converts 50% of damage they take into a delayed heal — the game's weirdest, best support tool, and by design the ONLY heal in the game: a conversion, never a pool.

moves.name: Flashpoint
moves.description: Detonates any of her cooling glass structures.

signature.name: Studio Fire
signature.description: An expanding ring of shimmering heat-haze; enemies inside take ramping burn and — the flourish — their weapons visibly droop and slag.

personality.summary: Loud, precise, and warm, in that order; flirts as punctuation; New Orleans to the bone and openly at war with Minnesota winter ("y'all CHOSE this?").

romance.notes: Non-exclusive with a live wire: PRIMACY. No exclusivity demand, but being demoted from "the one she calls first" triggers her unique consequence scene — one glass piece delivered to your base, unsigned, flawless, and cold.

recruitHook: Her studio's lease is a pawn in the Aldermen–Isles Trust land fight. Secure the building — buy it, leverage it, or burn the right document (her suggestion, delivered while making direct eye contact and a very thin wine glass).
differentiation: BINDING (docs/04 §1.8, design note §1): Anneal is the ONLY heal in the game and it is a CONVERSION, never a pool — no healer role by design.
Glasswork is the only player-made cover in the slice.
